subject: VoltGrid MSA & Order Form kickoff — templates, signer list, and evidence sync
messages:
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah@voltgrid.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@voltgrid.com
Date: 2026-12-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Kickoff: Redwood MSA & Order Form (VoltGrid)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the quick sync offer. We're ready to kick off contracting for the VoltGrid integration. Attached are: VoltGrid_SignerList.xlsx (primary signers + billing contact) and VoltGrid_MSA_redlines_v1.docx (our in-house edits to the MSA).

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm whether Redwood can accept our Exhibit A billing table as-is or if you prefer Redwood's template mapping.
- Data residency: US only (we will list regions in the signer sheet).
- SOC2 evidence and subprocessor list — we'd like to slot these into the intake so we can start procurement review asap.

Target timeline: internal target to sign order form by 2027-01-20.

Please advise next steps and who from Redwood legal should we expect on thread for the redline review.

Thanks,
Sarah Lopez
Procurement Manager, VoltGrid
[Attachment: VoltGrid_SignerList.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: VoltGrid_MSA_redlines_v1.docx (docx)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah@voltgrid.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-09T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood MSA & Order Form (VoltGrid)

Sarah —

Appreciate the materials and the clear target date. Looping in Kim (legal) and Marissa (contracts ops) to run a quick intake and map your redlines against our standard MSA.

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
1) We will convert your redline doc into a compare view and surface critical commercial/security flags by EOD tomorrow.
2) Kim will confirm whether your Exhibit A is compatible or whether we recommend the Redwood billing template mapping.
3) Ops (Marissa) will capture signer routing and any special signature authorities. Please confirm whether any signers require corporate board approval or e-signature restrictions.

Could you also confirm the billing contact email and whether VoltGrid requires invoice PDF delivery only or an SFTP for archived invoices?

Attaching our Redwood_Intake_Template.xlsx — please fill the short fields (billing contact, tax ID, ship-to/bill-to) so Marissa can populate the order form.

Thanks — I'll tag legal highlights in a follow-up.

Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Intake_Template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Sarah Lopez <sarah@voltgrid.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-09T15:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood MSA & Order Form (VoltGrid)

Thanks, Jonas & Sarah. Quick legal intake notes after a first pass on VoltGrid_MSA_redlines_v1.docx:

Summary of top-line items I see now (will provide a redline log by tomorrow AM):
- Liability cap: VoltGrid has proposed a 12-month cap tied to fees; Redwood prefers a 24-month cap or carveouts for IP and indemnity.
- Data residency / subprocessors: acceptable to keep US-only, but we need the subprocessor list before we confirm Exhibit D.
- SLA/credit language: redlines remove explicit credit mechanics; we'll propose a fallback that preserves uptime commitments with defined credit calculations.
- Exhibit A: VoltGrid's billing table has some nonstandard line items (usage buckets + connectors). We can map these, but will need the final usage forecast to validate tiers.

Marissa: once VoltGrid returns the intake sheet, please create a canonical mapping doc (redwood-template-mapping.xlsx) and tag required evidence (SOC2, penetration test summary, subprocessor attestation).

Sarah — can you confirm:
- Will VoltGrid accept the standard Redwood e-sign flow for both MSA and order form?
- Any PO number requirement at signature?

I'll include inline comments in the redline doc and propose a meeting to reconcile the liability and SLA language after Marissa completes mapping.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-template-mapping.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Sarah Lopez <sarah@voltgrid.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@voltgrid.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood MSA & Order Form (VoltGrid)

Thanks Kim, Jonas — answers below and a quick sync ask: 

- E-sign: yes, VoltGrid accepts DocuSign standard e-sign for both MSA and order form. We'll want the executed PDF for procurement records.
- PO: we will provide a PO (PO-7729) at time of order form signature; procurement will add PO to the HubSpot deal record.
- Billing contact: billing@voltgrid.com (cc'd is Daniel Wu, finance lead).
- Subprocessors: we can share the current subprocessor list (attached) and SOC2 report. Expect a separate email with those files this afternoon.
- Usage forecast: Daniel will send a short forecast CSV to help map Exhibit A tiers.

We are happy to do a 30-minute sync on Fri 2026-12-11 at 10:00 PT to walk through the liability/SLA reconcile. If that works, please send a calendar invite.

Sarah Lopez
Procurement Manager, VoltGrid
[Attachment: VoltGrid_subprocessor_list.csv (csv)]
